# Contributing

Small, focused improvements are welcome. Start with the [setup guide](../docs/setup.md) if you want to try the project, or [development checks](../docs/development.md) if you want to change it.

## Bugs and ideas

Use the issue templates and include the version or commit, the task you attempted, and the result. A short reproducible example is more useful than a long transcript. Share only logs or screenshots cleared of credentials, device identifiers, and personal app content.

Report security issues through [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/bal-r/eu-iphone-use/security/advisories/new), following the [security policy](SECURITY.md).

## Pull requests

Keep each change focused and explain the resulting behaviour. Include the checks you ran and any remaining device or host limitation. For UI changes, rebuild the committed preview asset. For phone behaviour, distinguish fixture results from tests on a physical device.

Follow the existing code style and keep runtime state, signing material, and local article drafts out of commits. Runner revisions, approved patch hashes, and dependency changes need a deliberate review together.

Changes are contributed under the project's [MIT licence](../LICENSE). See the [validation record](../docs/testing.md) for the current test coverage.
